subject: Life Sciences
title: Grade 12 Life Sciences Paper 2: Mock Exam

questions.scenario: Various options are given as possible answers to the following questions. Choose the correct answer.
questions.scenarioAf: Verskeie opsies word as moontlike antwoorde vir die volgende vrae gegee. Kies die korrekte antwoord.

questions.q: A nucleotide consists of …
questions.qAf: ’n Nukleotied bestaan uit …
options: a sugar, a phosphate and a nitrogenous base.
an amino acid, a sugar and a phosphate.
a base, an amino acid and a fatty acid.

questions.q: Codons are found on …
questions.qAf: Kodons word gevind op …

questions.q: Chromatids separate and move to opposite poles during …
questions.qAf: Chromatiede skei en beweeg na teenoorgestelde pole tydens …

questions.q: A human sperm cell contains … chromosomes.
questions.qAf: ’n Menslike spermsel bevat … chromosome.

questions.q: In a cross Aa × Aa, the proportion of offspring expected to be homozygous recessive is …
questions.qAf: In ’n kruising Aa × Aa is die verhouding nakomelinge wat na verwagting homosigoties resessief sal wees, …

questions.q: A carrier woman (XᴴXʰ) and a man with normal blood clotting (XᴴY) have a son. The probability that the son has haemophilia is …
questions.qAf: ’n Draervrou (XᴴXʰ) en ’n man met normale bloedstolling (XᴴY) het ’n seun. Die waarskynlikheid dat die seun hemofilie het, is …

questions.q: Organisms that can interbreed to produce fertile offspring belong to the same …
questions.qAf: Organismes wat kan kruisteel om vrugbare nakomelinge te lewer, behoort aan dieselfde …

questions.q: Which skull feature is evidence of bipedalism?
questions.qAf: Watter skedelkenmerk is ’n bewys van tweevoetigheid?
options: A foramen magnum placed forward, under the skull
optionsAf: ’n Foramen magnum wat vorentoe, onder die skedel geleë is

questions.q: Mitochondrial DNA is inherited from …
questions.qAf: Mitochondriale DNS word oorgeërf van …

questions.q: Punctuated equilibrium proposes that …
questions.qAf: Gepunktueerde ewewig stel voor dat …
options: evolution is always slow and gradual.
long periods of little change are interrupted by short periods of rapid change.
optionsAf: evolusie altyd stadig en geleidelik is.
lang tydperke van min verandering deur kort tydperke van vinnige verandering onderbreek word.

questions.scenario: Give the correct biological term for each of the following descriptions.
questions.scenarioAf: Gee die korrekte biologiese term vir elk van die volgende beskrywings.

questions.q: The type of RNA that carries amino acids to the ribosome
questions.qAf: Die soort RNS wat aminosure na die ribosoom dra

questions.q: Having two different alleles for a characteristic
questions.qAf: Om twee verskillende allele vir ’n eienskap te hê

questions.q: The weak bonds between complementary bases in DNA
questions.qAf: Die swak bindings tussen komplementêre basisse in DNS

questions.q: A diagram that shows how a characteristic is inherited in a family
questions.qAf: ’n Diagram wat wys hoe ’n eienskap in ’n familie oorgeërf word

questions.q: A permanent change in the sequence of bases in DNA
questions.qAf: ’n Permanente verandering in die volgorde van basisse in DNS

questions.q: The study of fossils
questions.qAf: Die studie van fossiele

questions.scenario: Indicate whether each of the descriptions applies to A ONLY, B ONLY, BOTH A AND B or NONE of the items.
questions.scenarioAf: Dui aan of elk van die beskrywings op SLEGS A, SLEGS B, BEIDE A EN B of GEEN van die items van toepassing is.

questions.q:
Takes place in the cytoplasm at the ribosomes
A: transcription B: translation
questions.qAf:
Vind in die sitoplasma by die ribosome plaas
A: transkripsie B: translasie

questions.q:
A source of genetic variation
A: mutation B: crossing over
questions.qAf:
’n Bron van genetiese variasie
A: mutasie B: oorkruising

questions.q:
A disorder caused by a recessive allele on the X chromosome
A: Down syndrome B: haemophilia
questions.qAf:
’n Afwyking wat deur ’n resessiewe alleel op die X-chromosoom veroorsaak word
A: Downsindroom B: hemofilie

questions.scenario: The base sequence of part of the template strand of a DNA molecule is: TAC CGT AAA ATC. The table shows some mRNA codons and the amino acids they code for.
questions.scenarioAf: Die basisvolgorde van ’n deel van die templaatstring van ’n DNS-molekule is: TAC CGT AAA ATC. Die tabel toon sommige mRNS-kodons en die aminosure waarvoor hulle kodeer.

questions.q: Write down the mRNA sequence formed from this template strand.
questions.qAf: Skryf die mRNS-volgorde neer wat vanaf hierdie templaatstring gevorm word.
points: AUG GCA UUU UAG
pointsAf: AUG GCA UUU UAG

questions.q: Write down the anticodon of the tRNA that brings the third amino acid.
questions.qAf: Skryf die antikodon neer van die tRNS wat die derde aminosuur bring.
points: AAA
pointsAf: AAA

questions.q: Use the table to give the sequence of amino acids coded for by this part of the DNA.
questions.qAf: Gebruik die tabel om die volgorde van aminosure te gee waarvoor hierdie deel van die DNS kodeer.
points: methionine – alanine – phenylalanine (UAG is a stop codon)
pointsAf: metionien – alanien – fenielalanien (UAG is ’n stopkodon)

questions.q: Name the organelle where translation takes place.
questions.qAf: Noem die organel waar translasie plaasvind.
points: ribosome
pointsAf: ribosoom

questions.q: A mutation changes the seventh base of the template strand from A to T. Explain the effect of this mutation on the protein.
questions.qAf: ’n Mutasie verander die sewende basis van die templaatstring van A na T. Verduidelik die uitwerking van hierdie mutasie op die proteïen.
points: The third mRNA codon changes from UUU to AUU
AUU codes for isoleucine instead of phenylalanine
a different amino acid may change the shape and function of the protein
pointsAf: Die derde mRNS-kodon verander van UUU na AUU
AUU kodeer vir isoleusien in plaas van fenielalanien
’n ander aminosuur kan die vorm en funksie van die proteïen verander

questions.scenario: An insecticide was sprayed regularly in a region to control malaria mosquitoes. The table shows the percentage of mosquitoes that were resistant to the insecticide.
questions.scenarioAf: ’n Insekdoder is gereeld in ’n streek gespuit om malariamuskiete te beheer. Die tabel toon die persentasie muskiete wat teen die insekdoder weerstandig was.

questions.q: What percentage of the mosquitoes were resistant in 2010?
questions.qAf: Watter persentasie van die muskiete was in 2010 weerstandig?

questions.q: Describe the trend shown by the data.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die neiging wat die data toon.
points: The percentage of resistant mosquitoes increased
from 5% in 2000 to 85% in 2020
pointsAf: Die persentasie weerstandige muskiete het toegeneem
van 5% in 2000 tot 85% in 2020

questions.q: Use the theory of natural selection to explain this trend.
questions.qAf: Gebruik die teorie van natuurlike seleksie om hierdie neiging te verduidelik.
points: There was variation: a few mosquitoes were naturally resistant
when the insecticide was sprayed, the non-resistant mosquitoes died
the resistant mosquitoes survived and reproduced
they passed the allele for resistance to their offspring, so the proportion of resistant mosquitoes increased
pointsAf: Daar was variasie: ’n paar muskiete was natuurlik weerstandig
wanneer die insekdoder gespuit is, het die nie-weerstandige muskiete doodgegaan
die weerstandige muskiete het oorleef en voortgeplant
hulle het die alleel vir weerstand aan hul nakomelinge oorgedra, dus het die verhouding weerstandige muskiete toegeneem

questions.q: Suggest TWO ways to slow down the development of resistance.
questions.qAf: Stel TWEE maniere voor om die ontwikkeling van weerstand te vertraag.
points: use the insecticide less often / rotate different insecticides
use other methods such as mosquito nets or removing standing water
pointsAf: gebruik die insekdoder minder gereeld / wissel verskillende insekdoders af
gebruik ander metodes soos muskietnette of die verwydering van staande water

questions.q: Name the organ where meiosis takes place in a human male.
questions.qAf: Noem die orgaan waar meiose in ’n menslike man plaasvind.
points: testes (seminiferous tubules)
pointsAf: testes (saadbuisies)

questions.q: Describe the events of prophase I.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die gebeure van profase I.
points: The chromatin condenses and the chromosomes become visible
homologous chromosomes pair up (form bivalents)
crossing over takes place at the chiasmata
the nuclear membrane disappears and the spindle forms
pointsAf: Die chromatien kondenseer en die chromosome word sigbaar
homoloë chromosome paar (vorm bivalente)
oorkruising vind by die chiasmata plaas
die kernmembraan verdwyn en die spoel vorm

questions.q: Give TWO differences between meiosis and mitosis.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE verskille tussen meiose en mitose.
points: Meiosis produces four haploid cells; mitosis produces two diploid cells
in meiosis crossing over takes place and the cells are genetically different; in mitosis there is no crossing over and the cells are identical
pointsAf: Meiose lewer vier haploïede selle; mitose lewer twee diploïede selle
in meiose vind oorkruising plaas en die selle is geneties verskillend; in mitose is daar geen oorkruising nie en die selle is identies

questions.q: How many chromosomes does a human skin cell have?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel chromosome het ’n menslike velsel?

questions.scenario: In cattle the allele for a black coat (B) is dominant over the allele for a red coat (b). A heterozygous black bull is crossed with a red cow.
questions.scenarioAf: By beeste is die alleel vir ’n swart haarkleed (B) dominant oor die alleel vir ’n rooi haarkleed (b). ’n Heterosigotiese swart bul word met ’n rooi koei gekruis.

questions.q: Use a genetic cross to show the possible genotypes and phenotypes of the offspring.
questions.qAf: Gebruik ’n genetiese kruising om die moontlike genotipes en fenotipes van die nakomelinge te toon.
points: P₁ phenotypes: black × red
genotypes: Bb × bb
meiosis: gametes B, b × b, b
fertilisation: F₁ genotypes Bb, Bb, bb, bb
phenotypes: 1 black : 1 red (50% each)
P₁, F₁, meiosis and fertilisation labelled
pointsAf: P₁-fenotipes: swart × rooi
genotipes: Bb × bb
meiose: gamete B, b × b, b
bevrugting: F₁-genotipes Bb, Bb, bb, bb
fenotipes: 1 swart : 1 rooi (50% elk)
P₁, F₁, meiose en bevrugting benoem

questions.q: If 20 calves are born from this cross, how many are expected to be red?
questions.qAf: As 20 kalwers uit hierdie kruising gebore word, hoeveel word verwag om rooi te wees?

questions.q: Explain the difference between genotype and phenotype.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik die verskil tussen genotipe en fenotipe.
points: Genotype is the genetic make-up (the alleles) of an organism
phenotype is its physical appearance (the characteristic that is expressed)
pointsAf: Genotipe is die genetiese samestelling (die allele) van ’n organisme
fenotipe is sy fisiese voorkoms (die eienskap wat uitgedruk word)

questions.scenario: In some cattle breeds, the alleles for a red coat (R) and a white coat (W) are both expressed: RW cattle are roan, with a mixture of red and white hairs.
questions.scenarioAf: By sommige beesrasse word die allele vir ’n rooi haarkleed (R) en ’n wit haarkleed (W) albei uitgedruk: RW-beeste is skimmel, met ’n mengsel van rooi en wit hare.

questions.q: Name the type of dominance shown.
questions.qAf: Noem die soort dominansie wat getoon word.
points: codominance
pointsAf: kodominansie

questions.q: Write down all the possible genotypes of the offspring of a roan bull and a white cow.
questions.qAf: Skryf al die moontlike genotipes neer van die nakomelinge van ’n skimmelbul en ’n wit koei.
points: RW
WW
pointsAf: RW
WW

questions.q: What is the probability that a calf from this cross is roan?
questions.qAf: Wat is die waarskynlikheid dat ’n kalf uit hierdie kruising skimmel is?

questions.q: Explain how a roan coat shows codominance.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe ’n skimmelhaarkleed kodominansie toon.
points: Both alleles are expressed in the phenotype
the coat has both red hairs and white hairs
neither allele is dominant and the colours do not blend
pointsAf: Albei allele word in die fenotipe uitgedruk
die haarkleed het beide rooi hare en wit hare
geen alleel is dominant nie en die kleure meng nie

questions.scenario: Haemophilia is caused by a recessive allele (Xʰ). A woman who is a carrier has children with a man who does not have haemophilia.
questions.scenarioAf: Hemofilie word deur ’n resessiewe alleel (Xʰ) veroorsaak. ’n Vrou wat ’n draer is, het kinders met ’n man wat nie hemofilie het nie.

questions.q: Explain why haemophilia is called a sex-linked disorder.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom hemofilie ’n geslagsgekoppelde afwyking genoem word.
points: The allele is carried on the X chromosome (a gonosome)
and there is no matching allele on the Y chromosome
pointsAf: Die alleel word op die X-chromosoom (’n gonosoom) gedra
en daar is geen ooreenstemmende alleel op die Y-chromosoom nie

questions.q: Write down the genotypes of the parents and determine the percentage of daughters who could be carriers and of sons who could have haemophilia.
questions.qAf: Skryf die genotipes van die ouers neer en bepaal die persentasie dogters wat draers kan wees en seuns wat hemofilie kan hê.
points: Parents: XᴴXʰ × XᴴY
offspring: XᴴXᴴ, XᴴXʰ, XᴴY, XʰY
50% of the daughters could be carriers
50% of the sons could have haemophilia
pointsAf: Ouers: XᴴXʰ × XᴴY
nakomelinge: XᴴXᴴ, XᴴXʰ, XᴴY, XʰY
50% van die dogters kan draers wees
50% van die seuns kan hemofilie hê

questions.q: Explain why haemophilia can be life-threatening.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom hemofilie lewensgevaarlik kan wees.
points: The blood does not clot properly
so even small injuries can lead to serious bleeding
pointsAf: Die bloed stol nie behoorlik nie
dus kan selfs klein beserings tot ernstige bloeding lei

questions.q: Explain what a genetically modified organism (GMO) is.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik wat ’n geneties gemodifiseerde organisme (GMO) is.
points: An organism whose DNA has been changed
by adding a gene from another organism (genetic engineering)
pointsAf: ’n Organisme waarvan die DNS verander is
deur ’n geen van ’n ander organisme by te voeg (genetiese manipulasie)

questions.q: Give TWO uses of DNA profiling.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE gebruike van DNS-profilering.
points: identifying criminals from DNA found at a crime scene
paternity testing / identifying bodies / tracing relatives
pointsAf: die identifisering van misdadigers uit DNS wat by ’n misdaadtoneel gevind is
vaderskaptoetse / die identifisering van lyke / die opspoor van familielede

questions.q: Give TWO arguments against using stem cells from human embryos.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE argumente teen die gebruik van stamselle uit menslike embrio’s.
points: the embryo is destroyed in the process
some people believe that life begins at fertilisation (religious or ethical objections)
pointsAf: die embrio word in die proses vernietig
sommige mense glo dat lewe by bevrugting begin (godsdienstige of etiese besware)

questions.q: Name the sugar found in DNA.
questions.qAf: Noem die suiker wat in DNS voorkom.
points: deoxyribose
pointsAf: deoksiribose

questions.q: Name the base that pairs with cytosine.
questions.qAf: Noem die basis wat met sitosien paar.
points: guanine
pointsAf: guanien

questions.q: Describe the process of DNA replication.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die proses van DNS-replikasie.
points: The DNA double helix unwinds
the weak hydrogen bonds between the bases break and the strands separate
each strand acts as a template
free nucleotides attach to the complementary bases (A–T, C–G)
two identical DNA molecules form, each with one old and one new strand
pointsAf: Die DNS-dubbelheliks ontrol
die swak waterstofbindings tussen die basisse breek en die stringe skei
elke string dien as ’n templaat
vry nukleotiede heg aan die komplementêre basisse (A–T, C–G)
twee identiese DNS-molekules vorm, elk met een ou en een nuwe string

questions.q: Give THREE differences between DNA and RNA.
questions.qAf: Gee DRIE verskille tussen DNS en RNS.
points: DNA is double-stranded; RNA is single-stranded
DNA has deoxyribose; RNA has ribose
DNA has thymine; RNA has uracil
pointsAf: DNS is dubbelstring; RNS is enkelstring
DNS het deoksiribose; RNS het ribose
DNS het timien; RNS het urasiel

questions.q: Explain what is meant by reproductive isolation.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik wat met reproduktiewe isolasie bedoel word.
points: Two populations can no longer interbreed
to produce fertile offspring
pointsAf: Twee bevolkings kan nie meer kruisteel nie
om vrugbare nakomelinge te lewer

questions.q: Over a long time, a mountain range rises and divides a population of beetles into two groups. Describe how the two groups could become two separate species.
questions.qAf: Oor ’n lang tyd styg ’n bergreeks en verdeel ’n bevolking kewers in twee groepe. Beskryf hoe die twee groepe twee afsonderlike spesies kan word.
points: The groups are geographically isolated
so there is no gene flow between them
the environments on the two sides are different
natural selection acts differently on each group
over many generations they become genetically and phenotypically different
until they can no longer interbreed, even if they meet again
pointsAf: Die groepe is geografies geïsoleer
dus is daar geen geenvloei tussen hulle nie
die omgewings aan die twee kante verskil
natuurlike seleksie werk verskillend op elke groep in
oor baie geslagte word hulle geneties en fenotipies verskillend
totdat hulle nie meer kan kruisteel nie, selfs al ontmoet hulle weer

questions.q: Give FOUR points of Darwin's theory of evolution by natural selection.
questions.qAf: Gee VIER punte van Darwin se teorie van evolusie deur natuurlike seleksie.
points: Organisms produce more offspring than can survive
there is variation among the offspring
those with favourable characteristics survive and reproduce
they pass these characteristics on, so the population changes over many generations
pointsAf: Organismes produseer meer nakomelinge as wat kan oorleef
daar is variasie onder die nakomelinge
dié met gunstige eienskappe oorleef en plant voort
hulle dra hierdie eienskappe oor, dus verander die bevolking oor baie geslagte

questions.q: Explain why Lamarck's theory is not accepted today.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom Lamarck se teorie vandag nie aanvaar word nie.
points: Characteristics acquired during a lifetime are not inherited
changes to body cells do not change the DNA in the gametes
pointsAf: Eienskappe wat gedurende ’n leeftyd verwerf word, word nie oorgeërf nie
veranderinge aan liggaamselle verander nie die DNS in die gamete nie

questions.scenario: The table compares some features of three hominids.
questions.scenarioAf: Die tabel vergelyk sommige kenmerke van drie hominiede.

questions.q: Describe the trend in cranial capacity shown in the table.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die neiging in kraniale kapasiteit wat in die tabel getoon word.
points: The cranial capacity increased
from 350 cm³ in Ardipithecus to 1 000 cm³ in Homo erectus
pointsAf: Die kraniale kapasiteit het toegeneem
van 350 cm³ by Ardipithecus tot 1 000 cm³ by Homo erectus

questions.q: Explain what the places where Homo erectus fossils have been found suggest.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik wat die plekke waar Homo erectus-fossiele gevind is, aandui.
points: The oldest Homo erectus fossils are in Africa, so it probably originated in Africa
it then migrated out of Africa
to Asia and Europe (supporting the Out of Africa hypothesis)
pointsAf: Die oudste Homo erectus-fossiele is in Afrika, dus het dit waarskynlik in Afrika ontstaan
dit het toe uit Afrika gemigreer
na Asië en Europa (wat die Uit Afrika-hipotese ondersteun)

questions.q: Give TWO ways in which the skull of a modern human differs from that of an ape.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE maniere waarop die skedel van ’n moderne mens van dié van ’n aap verskil.
points: a larger, rounded cranium
a flatter face with smaller jaws and brow ridges / a chin / a forward foramen magnum
pointsAf: ’n groter, ronde kranium
’n platter gesig met kleiner kake en wenkbrouriwwe / ’n ken / ’n vorentoe geplaasde foramen magnum

questions.q: Name the site in South Africa where the skeleton known as Little Foot was found.
questions.qAf: Noem die terrein in Suid-Afrika waar die skelet bekend as Little Foot gevind is.
points: Sterkfontein
pointsAf: Sterkfontein

questions.q: Explain how the use of tools and fire could have helped Homo erectus to survive.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe die gebruik van werktuie en vuur Homo erectus kon gehelp het om te oorleef.
points: Tools helped to hunt and to cut meat
cooking made food easier to chew and digest
so more energy was available, which could support a larger brain
fire gave warmth and protection from predators

kook het voedsel makliker gemaak om te kou en te verteer
dus was meer energie beskikbaar, wat ’n groter brein kon onderhou
vuur het warmte en beskerming teen roofdiere gegee

questions.q: Explain how biogeography supports the theory of evolution.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe biogeografie die teorie van evolusie ondersteun.
points: Similar species are found in nearby areas or on nearby islands
because they descended from a common ancestor that spread out and adapted to different environments
pointsAf: Soortgelyke spesies word in nabygeleë gebiede of op nabygeleë eilande gevind
omdat hulle afstam van ’n gemeenskaplike voorouer wat versprei en by verskillende omgewings aangepas het

questions.q: Explain how comparing the DNA of different species shows how closely they are related.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe die vergelyking van die DNS van verskillende spesies wys hoe nou hulle verwant is.
points: Species with more similar DNA sequences
share a more recent common ancestor
pointsAf: Spesies met meer soortgelyke DNS-volgordes
deel ’n meer onlangse gemeenskaplike voorouer

questions.q:
Describe how natural selection and geographic isolation can lead to the formation of a new species, and explain how genetic engineering is used to produce human insulin.
Content: 17 Synthesis: 3
NOTE: NO marks will be awarded for answers in the form of flow charts, tables or diagrams.
questions.qAf:
Beskryf hoe natuurlike seleksie en geografiese isolasie tot die vorming van ’n nuwe spesie kan lei, en verduidelik hoe genetiese manipulasie gebruik word om menslike insulien te produseer.
Inhoud: 17 Sintese: 3
LET WEL: GEEN punte sal toegeken word vir antwoorde in die vorm van vloeidiagramme, tabelle of diagramme nie.
points:
Natural selection (max 6)
There is variation within a population
more offspring are produced than can survive
there is competition for resources (a struggle for survival)
individuals with favourable characteristics are more likely to survive
and to reproduce
they pass the favourable alleles to their offspring
so over many generations the proportion of individuals with the favourable characteristics increases

Speciation (max 6)
A population is split into two by a geographic barrier (e.g. a river or mountains)
there is no gene flow between the two groups
the environments of the two groups differ
natural selection acts differently on each group
over many generations they become genetically and phenotypically different
they become reproductively isolated
and can no longer interbreed: they are now two species

Insulin production (max 5)
The human insulin gene is cut out of human DNA with a restriction enzyme
a plasmid is removed from a bacterium and cut with the same enzyme
the insulin gene is inserted into the plasmid (using ligase)
the recombinant plasmid is put back into a bacterium
the bacteria multiply quickly
and produce human insulin, which is extracted and purified
pointsAf:
Natuurlike seleksie (maks 6)
Daar is variasie binne ’n bevolking
meer nakomelinge word geproduseer as wat kan oorleef
daar is kompetisie vir hulpbronne (’n stryd om oorlewing)
individue met gunstige eienskappe sal meer waarskynlik oorleef
en voortplant
hulle dra die gunstige allele aan hul nakomelinge oor
dus neem die verhouding individue met die gunstige eienskappe oor baie geslagte toe

Spesiasie (maks 6)
’n Bevolking word deur ’n geografiese versperring (bv. ’n rivier of berge) in twee verdeel
daar is geen geenvloei tussen die twee groepe nie
die omgewings van die twee groepe verskil
natuurlike seleksie werk verskillend op elke groep in
oor baie geslagte word hulle geneties en fenotipies verskillend
hulle word reproduktief geïsoleer
en kan nie meer kruisteel nie: hulle is nou twee spesies

Insulienproduksie (maks 5)
Die menslike insulien-geen word met ’n restriksie-ensiem uit menslike DNS gesny
’n plasmied word uit ’n bakterie verwyder en met dieselfde ensiem gesny
die insulien-geen word in die plasmied ingevoeg (met ligase)
die rekombinante plasmied word terug in ’n bakterie geplaas
die bakterieë vermeerder vinnig
en produseer menslike insulien, wat onttrek en gesuiwer word

questions.q: Synthesis
questions.qAf: Sintese
